metadata.chunk_label: voice_input Swift & Rust voice input systems
metadata.note: Files listed in task manifest do not exist; extraction performed on actual codebase structure in voice_input/ and voice_input_rust/

nodes.name: VoiceInputPipeline
nodes.description: Main orchestrator for voice input processing pipeline (FR-2). Coordinates VAD, streaming ASR, batch ASR, refiner engine, and validation.

nodes.name: VADEngine
nodes.description: Voice Activity Detection engine protocol (FR-5.1). Detects speech presence in audio chunks.

nodes.name: StreamingASREngine
nodes.description: Streaming ASR (Auto Speech Recognition) engine protocol (FR-5.1). Processes audio chunks for real-time preview.

nodes.name: BatchASREngine
nodes.description: Batch ASR engine protocol (FR-5.1). Transcribes complete audio data after recording ends.

nodes.name: RefinerEngine
nodes.description: LLM refiner engine protocol (FR-5.1). Refines raw ASR output text with context-aware rules.

nodes.name: AudioChunk
nodes.description: Captured audio data chunk with sample rate and channel info.

nodes.name: VADStatus
nodes.description: Voice activity detection status: silence, speechStarted, speaking, speechEnded.

nodes.name: OutputValidator
nodes.description: Validates ASR output (FR-2.4). Checks for empty text, repetitive loops, language mismatch.

nodes.name: DummyVADEngine
nodes.description: Fallback VAD using energy detection. Implements VADEngine protocol.

nodes.name: AppleSpeechAnalyzerEngine
nodes.description: Apple Speech Framework ASR adapter. Implements both StreamingASREngine and BatchASREngine protocols.

nodes.name: RuleBasedRefinerEngine
nodes.description: Rule-based LLM refiner (FR-3). Removes fillers, applies corrections, dictionary substitution, punctuation.

nodes.name: EngineFactory
nodes.description: Factory for creating engine instances from config names (FR-5.1, FR-5.2).

nodes.name: UserDictionaryManager
nodes.description: Manages user custom dictionary (FR-6). Supports JSON/CSV import/export.

nodes.name: UserDictionaryItem
nodes.description: Individual dictionary entry with reading, target, and enabled flag.

nodes.name: AudioCaptureManager
nodes.description: Manages audio capture from microphone using AVAudioEngine. Produces AudioChunks via callback.

nodes.name: AppState
nodes.description: Observable object managing app-wide state (FR-1, FR-4.3): recording status, preview text, history.

nodes.name: HistoryItem
nodes.description: Timestamped history entry for transcribed text (FR-4.3, FR-4.4).

nodes.name: RefinerContext
nodes.description: Context information for refiner engine: dictionary, app category, refinement strength (FR-3).

nodes.name: TextInserter
nodes.description: Inserts text into target application (FR-4.1). Manages focus restoration via FocusManager.

nodes.name: FocusManager
nodes.description: Manages application focus capture and restoration (FR-4.2).

nodes.name: AudioRecorder
nodes.description: Records audio using cpal, stores in AudioBuffer. Produces Whisper-compatible samples.

nodes.name: AudioBuffer
nodes.description: Circular buffer for audio samples. Handles stereo-to-mono conversion and 16kHz resampling.

nodes.name: UserDictionary
nodes.description: User dictionary with HashMap-backed reading→target mappings.

nodes.name: TextInserter
nodes.description: Inserts transcribed text via clipboard and keyboard simulation. Restores focus on macOS.

nodes.name: macos_focus
nodes.description: macOS-specific PID capture and focus restoration using Objective-C objc2 bindings.

nodes.name: VoiceInputApp (egui)
nodes.description: egui desktop application. Sets up custom Japanese fonts and manages app lifecycle.

nodes.name: AppConfig
nodes.description: Application configuration with engine name mappings (FR-5.2).
